# Interface Route

All Known Implementing Classes:
    `[Route.Default](Route.Default.html "enum class in com.google.adk.workflow"), [Route.Flag](Route.Flag.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow"), [Route.Num](Route.Num.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow"), [Route.Tag](Route.Tag.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow")`

* * *

[@Experimental](../annotations/Experimental.html "annotation interface in com.google.adk.annotations") public sealed interface Route permits [Route.Tag](Route.Tag.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow"), [Route.Num](Route.Num.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow"), [Route.Flag](Route.Flag.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow"), [Route.Default](Route.Default.html "enum class in com.google.adk.workflow")

A value on a workflow edge, and the value a node emits to select which of its outgoing edges are followed. An edge fires when the value it carries matches one the node emitted. 

On the wire a route is a bare scalar (a string, integer or boolean), and [`Route.Default`](Route.Default.html "enum class in com.google.adk.workflow") is the `DEFAULT_ROUTE_SENTINEL` string.

# Record Class Edge

[java.lang.Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class in java.lang")

[java.lang.Record](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Record.html "class in java.lang")

com.google.adk.workflow.Edge

Record Components:
    `from` \- The node whose completion fires this edge.
    `to` \- The node this edge triggers.
    `routes` \- The routes that select this edge. An empty list makes the edge unconditional.

* * *

[@Experimental](../annotations/Experimental.html "annotation interface in com.google.adk.annotations") public record Edge([Node](Node.html "interface in com.google.adk.workflow") from, [Node](Node.html "interface in com.google.adk.workflow") to, com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<[Route](Route.html "interface in com.google.adk.workflow")> routes) extends [Record](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Record.html "class in java.lang")

A connection between two nodes in a workflow graph. An edge with no routes fires whenever its source completes; any other edge fires only when one of its routes is selected, as [`Route`](Route.html "interface in com.google.adk.workflow") describes.

# Class Workflow

[java.lang.Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class in java.lang")

[com.google.adk.workflow.BaseNode](BaseNode.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow")

com.google.adk.workflow.Workflow

All Implemented Interfaces:
    `[Node](Node.html "interface in com.google.adk.workflow")`

* * *

[@Experimental](../annotations/Experimental.html "annotation interface in com.google.adk.annotations") public final class Workflow extends [BaseNode](BaseNode.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow")

A graph of nodes that is itself a node, so a workflow can go wherever a node can, including in another workflow.

  * ## Nested Class Summary

`builder()`

 

`com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<[Edge](Edge.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow")>`

`edges()`

Returns the edges of the workflow's graph.

`[Optional](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/util/Optional.html "class in java.util")<[Integer](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Integer.html "class in java.lang")>`

`maxConcurrency()`

Returns the maximum number of nodes the workflow runs at once, or empty if there is no limit.

`io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Flowable<?>`

public io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Flowable<?> runNode([Context](../agents/Context.html "class in com.google.adk.agents") context, @Nullable [Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class in java.lang") nodeInput)

Description copied from interface: `[Node](Node.html#runNode\(com.google.adk.agents.Context,java.lang.Object\))`

Runs the node on `nodeInput`, the output it receives from its predecessors. 

An emitted [`Event`](../events/Event.html "class in com.google.adk.events") passes through, and any other emitted value becomes the node's output (at most one per run); emit nothing for no output, since RxJava forbids null. The wildcard lets an implementation return a `Flowable` of its own type.

public static final class Workflow.Builder extends [Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class in java.lang")

Builder for [`Workflow`](Workflow.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow"). Only the name is required. Unlike other nodes, a workflow reruns from scratch when resumed unless `rerunOnResume` turns that off.

On a rewind event, the ID of the invocation to rewind before: the history from that invocation up to the rewind event is dropped. ADK Java does not apply rewinds itself; the field exists for runtimes that do, such as ADK Kotlin.

    * ### route

[@Experimental](../annotations/Experimental.html "annotation interface in com.google.adk.annotations") public [Optional](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/util/Optional.html "class in java.util")<com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList<[Route](../workflow/Route.html "interface in com.google.adk.workflow")>> route()

For a workflow node, returns the routes this event selects; an edge is followed when it has one of these routes. The value is optional because an empty list is still a routing decision that selects no route, whereas an absent value means the event makes no routing decision. When merging, an empty list replaces the existing routes, while an absent value keeps them.

# Class JoinNode

[java.lang.Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class in java.lang")

[com.google.adk.workflow.BaseNode](BaseNode.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow")

com.google.adk.workflow.JoinNode

All Implemented Interfaces:
    `[Node](Node.html "interface in com.google.adk.workflow")`

* * *

[@Experimental](../annotations/Experimental.html "annotation interface in com.google.adk.annotations") public final class JoinNode extends [BaseNode](BaseNode.html "class in com.google.adk.workflow")

A node that waits for every predecessor to complete, then outputs their outputs keyed by predecessor name. Route each predecessor into the join every time it completes: one that routes elsewhere still counts as complete, and if it completes last, the join never runs.

  * ## Nested Class Summary

`boolean`

`requiresAllPredecessors()`

# Class CacheMetadata

[java.lang.Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class in java.lang")

[com.google.adk.JsonBaseModel](../JsonBaseModel.html "class in com.google.adk")

com.google.adk.models.CacheMetadata

* * *

public abstract class CacheMetadata extends [JsonBaseModel](../JsonBaseModel.html "class in com.google.adk")

Context cache state carried on an LLM response, and on its event, from one request to the next. 

Metadata for an active cache has a `cacheName()`, `expireTime()` and `invocationsUsed()`. Fingerprint-only metadata has none of them: it records the cacheable prefix so that a later request can tell whether the prefix is still the same.

# Class ComputerUseTool

[java.lang.Object](https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/17/docs/api/java.base/java/lang/Object.html "class in java.lang")

com.google.adk.tools.computeruse.ComputerUseTool

* * *

public class ComputerUseTool extends [FunctionTool](../FunctionTool.html "class in com.google.adk.tools")

A tool that wraps computer control functions for use with LLMs. 

This tool automatically normalizes coordinates from a virtual coordinate space (by default 1000x1000) to the actual screen size.

# Interface BaseComputer

* * *

public interface BaseComputer

Defines an interface for computer environments. 

This interface defines the standard methods for controlling computer environments, including web browsers and other interactive systems.

  * ## Method Summary
